# Past issues

Historical context for issues resolved through pull requests. Active reports belong in [KNOWN_ISSUES.md](../KNOWN_ISSUES.md); the workflow is defined in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

No issues have been resolved through this tracker yet. Do not archive open audit findings merely because they have been documented.

For each resolution, preserve the full original issue record and append:

- **Disposition:** Fixed / Duplicate / Not reproducible / Won't fix
- **Resolution date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Reporting reference:** PR/commit when available
- **Resolution reference:** PR/commit when available; never invent a merge SHA
- **Resolution and rationale:** What changed or why the issue was closed
- **Verification:** UI reproduction outcome, environment/revision, relevant regression checks and limitations
- **Reopening history:** Date, reason, and link to the active entry if the defect recurs

An archive move proposed in a PR takes effect when that PR merges into main. Preserve stable issue IDs permanently.
